what: After operator cable clearance, the planned 8-degree wrist sweep was rejected before enable by inconsistent velocity feedback.
why: Retain truthful hardware evidence and avoid treating near-constant encoder readings as proof that a conflicting velocity signal is harmless.
details: At 16:45 Pacific, one preflight sample reported -5.079 deg/s while position spanned one 0.02198-degree count. Subsequent 50-sample inspection on each arm found near-constant encoder positions and varying reported velocity. A 1.10-second experimental encoder-window diagnostic also failed velocity consistency. No motor enabled. New diagnostic is enforced read-only; powered-test guards unchanged. 100 overview frames retained locally.
